19:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football Countdown
A look at the day's college football action, featuring news, highlights and game previews.

19:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Baylor Bears visit the UCF Knights for a Big 12 game. The Baylor Bears fell 25-24 to the Kansas Jayhawks in their last outing, while the UCF Knights defeated the No. 2 BYU Cougars 39-31 in double overtime steered by quarterback Keyone Jenkins.
